seg.seg_rev_note: Two segments: Freight Group and Transit Group. Segment sales = sales to external customers as published. Note: Wabtec later reclassified some businesses between segments (e.g., Q1-14 10-Q shows Q1-13 Freight $313.7m / Transit $301.8m vs. originally reported $305.9m / $309.6m); figures here are as originally reported.
seg.notes: Segment income from operations (and Corporate Activities & Elimination) from the 10-Q segment note; the release does not publish segment operating income. legacy_pl = three-month 'Sales by product' table from the 10-Q segment note (as originally reported). Bridge from Q2-13 10-Q MD&A narrative: acquisitions +$49.0m (Freight $15.0m, Transit $34.0m); FX reduced sales $3.7m (Freight $3.0m, Transit $0.7m). Organic not stated.

ngaap.guidance: Increased 2013 guidance for EPS to $2.98-$3.03 (post-split), with revenues expected to be up about 8 percent for the year.
ngaap.notes: No adjusted results published. 2-for-1 stock split effective May 14 / June 11, 2013; per-share data in this release are post-split.
